integrity: Self-contained finite-field proof with exact small-case independent verification; counts and scripts embedded.
scientific_limitations: Only dimension-two linear codes, labeled coordinates, uniform sampling with replacement. Population is of distinct code subspaces, not matroid isomorphism types. Earlier general recovery formulas subsume the elementary expectation identity; novelty is the exact code census and asymptotic arithmetic rarity. Possible implicit older enumeration remains a priority risk; no independent audit.
title: Exact census and arithmetic rarity of rank-two recovery-balanced linear codes
